VI.description: The RemoteVI server: ONE While Loop\2C no event structure (docs\5Carchitecture.md\2C tools\5Cmock-server\5Cserver.mjs). Before the loop it creates a TCP listener on port (all interfaces)\2C obtains the notifier named stop notifier name and reads the name of VI for the title. Each iteration waits at most 5 ms for a connection and hands it to RemoteVI Handle Connection.vi (at most 8 WebSocket clients)\3B an upgraded connection gets the text messages title and viewonly 0 and joins the client list. POPUPS (docs\5Carchitecture.md\2C section Popups)\3A while a LabVIEW popup (menu\2C drop-down\2C graph palette popup) is open\2C LabVIEW's UI thread is in a modal loop and every VI Server UI call blocks\2C so each iteration first lists the popups with RemoteVI Find Popups.vi (Win32 only\3B class SysShadow\2C a menu's drop shadow\2C is ignored) - whenever a client is connected\2C a popup was open last time or the geometry is due. The loop caches the panel's geometry and window handle (RemoteVI Get Panel Geometry.vi before the loop\2C then every 500 ms and right after a popup closes\2C but only while NO popup is open) and the last panel capture. Every client is serviced (RemoteVI Service Client.vi) with the cached geometry\2C handle and the popup state\3B when at least one client is connected and 1000/fps ms have passed\2C a frame is made once and RemoteVI Send Frame.vi runs for each client. Without a popup the frame is a fresh capture (RemoteVI Capture Panel.vi)\2C which also becomes the cache. With a popup open NO VI Server call is made\3A the frame is the cached capture with each popup's screen pixels (RemoteVI Capture Screen Rect.vi) pasted in at its position relative to the panel origin\2C clipped to the panel\2C bottom-most popup first. After a client posted a message that may open a popup (Service Client's clicked?) the loop also makes no VI Server UI call for 300 ms\2C so a popup that is still opening cannot catch FP.Get Image in its modal loop (measured\3A that froze the loop until the menu was closed on the host). A minimized panel is restored (RemoteVI Restore If Minimized.vi) when a client connects. Closed clients are dropped and their connections closed. The loop stops when the notifier delivers anything\2C when VI is no longer running (Execution\3AState checked once a second while no popup is open - so the server ends with your application)\2C or on a listener error other than a timeout. Then every connection and the listener are closed and the notifier released. Launched asynchronously by RemoteVI Start.vi.
